d:
hello
this is an updated version of the first volume of HOME
it should look and read better overall
I wasn't terribly happy with the old version so I redid it
unfortunately im unable to simply update the old version since it's been too long, so I have to reupload it; the old gallery should be expunged sooner or later

vol 1 in particular annoyed me since it was really haphazardly thrown together by me, so im glad to have it fixed at least a bit
now that im aware of the expunging requirement, i may or may not go through the process of revamping the other volumes, specifically 2 and 3, since although they also (in my eyes) require touchups, it's not to this extent, and honestly, it sounds like a hassle (like having to remake the gallery entirely for a single typo i found in volume 4)

see you all in like half a year or whatever for whatever or whatever
